methodology.processIsolation: fresh process and fixed pool per configuration
methodology.outputBytes: exact typed-array payload bytes for retained large/matrix outputs; completion messages contain no task output
methodology.rss: process-wide 2ms sampling plus endpoints; no forced GC or baseline subtraction
methodology.eventLoop: monitorEventLoopDelay, eventLoopUtilization delta, and an independent 1ms timer drift probe
methodology.piscina: bounded manual producer; completion tasks explicitly return undefined; this is a generic transport comparison, not an equivalent algorithm API
methodology.asyncResource: same-process allocation/scope micro-control; none and per-child are synthetic and not alternate runtime implementations
